messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up — I'm drafting the release notes / changelog for 0.9.3. Focus is feature announcements + known issues (streaming + caching edge case). I opened a PR with the draft and SDK snippet examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

Tom Nguyen: On it. I'll skim the snippet accuracy and the SDK examples. Any specific wording you want for the known-issue callout?

Priya Shah: Want it short and clear, like: 'Known issue: short-lived streaming sessions may drop trailing tokens when KV cache is reused across warm restarts. Workaround: disable prefix caching for streaming or pin to model v0.9.2 until a hotfix lands.' Thoughts?

Alex Rivera: I like the wording but suggest we avoid 'hotfix' in public notes — maybe 'fix in an upcoming patch'. Also add a customer-facing note for Dedicated: 'Dedicated customers on pinned infra may see different behavior; contact support if affected.'

Maria Gomez: Also flag that the Python SDK snippet needed an import line (`from redwood import Client`) — I saw a prod issue where folks copy/paste and forget it. Might add a tiny one-liner usage example under 'SDK snippets'.

Priya Shah: Good call. Updated the PR description with Alex's wording and Maria's import. Snippet I put in the PR:```markdown
### Python SDK quick example
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this text")
print(resp.text)
```
I'll also add the Dedicated note beneath 'Deployment notes'.

docs-bot: Link checker report for PR #842: 1 broken link detected -> /docs/migration/old-quantization (404). See details: https://ci.redwood.dev/link-checker/842

Tom Nguyen: That broken migration link is from the migration guide TOC — I remember we removed that page last month. Quick fix: point to /docs/migration/quantization-modes which consolidates both older pages. I'll push a tiny commit to the PR.

Priya Shah: Thanks Tom — please add a redirect in the PR too if possible. We should avoid expanding user-facing 404s in relnotes.

Tom Nguyen: Pushed commit fixing link + added a `docs: redirect` file. Also ran local link-checker; passes now.

Alex Rivera: Quick nit: can we move the 'Known issues' to its own collapsible section so it doesn't look like a blocker for upgrades? e.g., `<details>` in the markdown. That keeps the release highlights clean.

Priya Shah: Good idea. I'll reformat.

Maria Gomez: LGTM from me on content and snippet. One more ask: can we include a one-liner about telemetry — 'no opt-in changes' — customers asked yesterday.

Priya Shah: Added telemetry sentence. Final checklist: wording review (done), snippet import (done), migration link fix (done), collapsible known-issues (done), Dedicated callout (done). Anyone object to merging after CI passes?

Tom Nguyen: No objections. CI green locally, waiting on CI run from main.

docs-bot: CI status for PR #842: checks queued -> link-checker, markdown-lint, preview-build.

Priya Shah: I'll wait for CI then merge. If anything else pops up, please flag in the thread. Thanks all :tada:

Alex Rivera: Thanks — will post a short announcement draft for the #announcements channel once merged.

Maria Gomez: Great work. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: CI status for PR #842: all checks passed.

Priya Shah: Merged the PR and published the release notes to /docs/changelog/0.9.3. Follow-up: create a short redwood.dev/blog blurb tomorrow.

Tom Nguyen: Noted — will monitor for any rollback requests.

Priya Shah: Closing the thread. If we spot any post-publish typos, I can do a quick patch. Thanks everyone!"
